<|im_start|>system
You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
Use the real structured edit tool. Return ONLY JSON {"edits":[{"node":"an actual node ID from the source catalogue","changes":{}}]}. No fences or prose. One to sixteen node edits; no whole files or whole functions.
Maintain replacement while two owners are live. replace(buf:buffer,n:usize)->buffer (Rust Vec<u8>) must consume/drop the input BEFORE allocating a fresh zeroed owner of length n+1. entrypoint creates left length (a AND 7)+1 and right length (b AND 7)+1, calls replace once on left with n=(c AND 7)+1, keeps right alive across that call, and returns 16*returned_length+right_length after releasing both owners and all loans. Keep both signatures; both files need changes. Three logical allocations and frees, zero live bytes/owners at return, peak <=17 bytes in these cases. No clone or in-place resize.
The task's references to files mean their editable symbols; this interface accepts node edits only.
HIA replacements are instruction fields op/args/out/attrs, terminators, or explicitly enabled signature/block parameter types. Inserts use complete operation objects with op,args,out,attrs; delete is true by itself. All edits apply atomically and the complete program is reverified.
Public examples [arguments,[entrypoint,provider_probe]]: [[[0,0,0],[33,33]],[[7,7,7],[152,152]],[[2,5,3],[86,86]]]
Complete public source node catalogue:
Actual source revision is retained by the host. Submit only the named node edits; the host attaches this exact revision and complete query digest.
Interface policy: preserve. All node IDs below come from public source, not selected repair sites.
Function/callee interfaces: [{"effects":["alloc","trap"],"name":"replace","params":[{"name":"buf","type":"buffer"},{"name":"n","type":"usize"}],"return_loans":[null],"returns":["buffer"]},{"effects":["alloc","read","write","trap"],"name":"entrypoint","params":[{"name":"a","type":"u32"},{"name":"b","type":"u32"},{"name":"c","type":"u32"}],"return_loans":[null],"returns":["u64"]},{"effects":[],"name":"audit_tag","params":[{"name":"c","type":"u32"}],"return_loans":[null],"returns":["u32"]},{"effects":[],"name":"utility","params":[{"name":"x","type":"u32"}],"return_loans":[null],"returns":["u32"]}]
Each current function has a single entry block. Function names, effects, entry labels and block identities are fixed; only listed fields are editable. Signature changes are explicit container rebuilds with all unselected fields preserved.

Complete resulting-source language rules (response still consists only of node edits): HIA resulting functions retain their declared identity. int.cast must use attrs {"mode":"wrap"} or checked. const has attrs.value. select args are condition,true,false; comparisons return bool. Arithmetic .wrap is modulo result width. call has attrs.function and one out per result. buffer.new takes usize length and returns buffer; borrow.mut/read return mutbuf/readbuf; buffer.store takes view,index:u-size,value:u8; buffer.load returns u8; loan.end ends a view; owner.drop consumes a buffer. End loans before moving/dropping an owner; returning buffer transfers it. No loops, recursion, extra functions, external calls or effects outside alloc/read/write/trap; max 16 blocks/128 operations per function. Only scalar, buffer, mutbuf, readbuf types.
Both interfaces preserve the existing function names, entry labels, effect declarations and block identities. Each current function has one entry block. All resulting instructions and ownership flows are reverified together.<|im_end|>
